summary: Iteration 69 — Companion saints + 33-Day St. Joseph Consecration. Both backend (25/25 pytest) and frontend (mobile viewport) flows pass end-to-end. Companion GET returns name, importance, virtues[], novena_slug, daily_act, has_consecration, is_joseph for all 5 requested slugs (francis-assisi, catherine-siena, st-joseph, monica, therese-lisieux) and 404 for unknown. /companions/{slug}/image returns a Gemini-generated data:image/jpeg url for francis-assisi and st-joseph (cached). All 10 new companion novena detail endpoints resolve and appear in /novenas list. Consecration: overview returns 33 days + set_times + daily_prayer + act_of_consecration; POST /start creates active enrollment (current_day=1); day/1 returns AI meditation with act_of_consecration=null; day/33 returns act_of_consecration; complete-day advances; stop ends; day 0/34 → 404. Frontend Vocation → 'Open St. Joseph's space' link works, Companion screen renders hero illustration + importance + daily act + virtues + Virtus / Novena / Consecration buttons; novena button navigates to /novenas/st-francis-assisi; consecration button to /consecration. Prayer hub shows 'Consecration to St. Joseph' card → /consecration. Consecration screen renders intro + start dates + 33-day list with consec-begin; after begin, shows Day X of 33 + meditation + daily prayer + 'Mark day complete' which advances to Day 2.
critical_code_review_comments: companions.py: image generation is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task on every GET /companions/{slug} — fine because _get_or_make_image short-circuits on cache hit, but could be guarded by a per-slug lock to avoid concurrent duplicate generations on first hit.

consecration.py: complete-day uses set semantics and recomputes status correctly; consider explicitly returning the active enrollment when status=='completed' too (currently returns None) so the client can show a completion summary.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/consecration/start was called multiple times for test user (philipwils13@gmail.com) with start_date 2026-06-26 then stopped. Also completed Day 1 once during UI smoke. Mongo collections affected: consecration_enrollments (active row for this user), consecration_meditations (cached AI meditations for day 1, 33), companion_images (cached images for francis-assisi, st-joseph).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Companion image generation requires Emergent LLM key + emergentintegrations.LlmChat using gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview. After the first hit it is cached forever in companion_images collection. Consecration meditations cached in consecration_meditations (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929). Frontend uses test_feat_aug25 bearer token via localStorage.setItem('sanctus_session_token', JSON.stringify('test_feat_aug25')).
